grades.reason: Covers Smcdeleg counter delegation (siselect/sireg access rules). It says nothing about medeleg or how software discovers which exceptions can be delegated.
Covers mideleg, which is for interrupts, and the read-only-one bits when the H extension is present. It does not cover medeleg or how to discover which exceptions can be delegated.
Describes when virtual-instruction exceptions are raised in VS-mode and how they relate to illegal-instruction traps. It does not explain how to probe medeleg for delegable exceptions.
